summary: Flexible Solutions International Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an ATM Sales Agreement with Bancroft Capital, LLC on June 30, 2026. The agreement allows the Company to sell up to $18.5 million of its common stock from time to time through the Sales Agent. The Company will pay a 3% cash fee on gross proceeds plus up to $30,000 in expense reimbursement. The offering is made under an effective Form S-3 shelf registration statement. This is a routine capital markets activity, not a special situation.
